skill.summary: professionals and marketers edit raw video footage into LinkedIn-ready videos using this skill. Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB, renders on cloud GPU...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI LinkedIn Video Editor initial release:

- Lets users edit and export LinkedIn-optimized videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; max 500MB; 1080p).
- Integrates cloud GPU rendering for fast, server-side video processing (1–2 min typical turnaround).
- Provides guided setup, automatic token/session handling, and user feedback on connection status.
- Supports upload, editing (trim, captions, formatting), preview, export, and session/balance management.
- Handles errors (tokens, credits, file size/type) and common workflows for LinkedIn video content.
